name: atni-resolution-library
title: The Resolution Library (clean, public)
description: The Resolution Library was built by Wyatt Ash-Milby at ATNI. T0 (D-081). Cleaned through a recorded ledger; values as written are kept beside normalized values; every value carries its basis (recorded, owner, likely, open; D-083).

fields.name: committee_key
fields.description: stable key of a committee entity (the ledger committee_key)

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: proposed display name (new_value of the ledger committee record)

fields.name: kind
fields.description: entity kind from the ledger

fields.name: parent_key
fields.description: proposed parent committee; NULL if none

fields.name: name_confirmed
fields.description: 1 when the basis of the ledger record is recorded or owner, else 0

fields.name: source_names
fields.description: the source workbook's own names for the entity as the ledger records them (old_value of the committee record)

fields.name: labels
fields.description: 'label (n); ...': every ledger label that names this key, applied or proposed; n = listed resolutions with that label and a link to the key; by n descending, then label; NULL if the key has no label

fields.name: first_year
fields.description: smallest year over listed resolutions with an applied link; NULL if none

fields.name: last_year
fields.description: largest year over listed resolutions with an applied link; NULL if none

fields.name: n_resolutions
fields.description: listed resolutions with an applied link to the key

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.description: id of the ledger row that defines the entity

fields.name: name_basis
fields.description: basis of display_name (the ledger basis of the committee record): recorded, owner (decided by ATNI), likely or open

fields.name: kind_basis
fields.description: basis of kind and parent_key (the ledger kind_basis)

fields.name: n_resolutions_likely
fields.description: listed resolutions whose applied links to the key are all likely (counted inside n_resolutions)

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.description: id of the ledger row (committee_map, record label)

fields.name: label_as_written
fields.description: the exact string of one Committee cell

fields.name: part_order
fields.description: position of the part inside the cell, from 1

fields.name: relation
fields.description: the ledger's reading of the part (a code word)

fields.name: committee_key
fields.description: committee the part names; NULL when the part names none

fields.name: status
fields.description: applied when the ledger class is auto, keep or likely, else proposed

fields.name: first_year
fields.description: copied from the ledger

fields.name: last_year
fields.description: copied from the ledger

fields.name: n_cells
fields.description: copied from the ledger

fields.name: n_resolutions
fields.description: copied from the ledger (counts listed resolutions)

fields.name: basis
fields.description: the ledger basis of the label row

fields.name: person_key
fields.description: stable key of a person entity (the ledger person_key)

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: display name (new_value of the ledger person record)

fields.name: name_confirmed
fields.description: 1 when the basis of the ledger record is recorded or owner, else 0

fields.name: forms
fields.description: 'form (n); ...': the person's forms as the Prepared By cells write them; n = listed resolutions with that form; by n descending, then form

fields.name: first_year
fields.description: smallest year over listed resolutions with an applied preparer row of the person; NULL if none

fields.name: last_year
fields.description: largest year over listed resolutions with an applied preparer row of the person; NULL if none

fields.name: n_resolutions
fields.description: listed resolutions with an applied preparer row of the person

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.description: id of the ledger row that defines the entity

fields.name: basis
fields.description: likely when a form joins the person by a likely merge or the ledger record is likely; owner when the record basis is owner; else recorded

fields.name: years_present
fields.description: distinct years over listed resolutions with an applied preparer row of the person

fields.name: form
fields.description: a name exactly as one Prepared By part writes it (ledger part_text)

fields.name: person_key
fields.description: the person the form belongs to

fields.name: n_resolutions
fields.description: listed resolutions with that form

fields.name: basis
fields.description: basis of the form membership: the strongest basis among the ledger parts that write the form

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: 'atni:<kind>:<year>'

fields.name: year
fields.description: year of the session

fields.name: kind
fields.description: session kind

fields.name: labels_as_written
fields.description: distinct non-blank Conf. cell strings of the session's listed resolutions, sorted and '; '-joined; '' when all were derived

fields.name: n_resolutions
fields.description: listed resolutions of the session

fields.name: first_number
fields.description: smallest number among them (by year, then sequence)

fields.name: last_number
fields.description: largest number among them

fields.name: place

fields.name: place_source

fields.name: place_texts
fields.description: distinct published documents of the session read for the place (each counted once)

fields.name: place_naming

fields.name: place_usable
fields.description: documents read whose published convention_location gives a usable town (the denominator of the majority)

fields.description: 1 for a resolution that is listed; 0 for a draft-numbered entry that is kept as written in the library, left out of every count and absent from the public export

fields.name: not_listed_reason
